answer: A work receipt is split into shards with a fresh nonce per submission and handed to auditors who cannot see each other's copy, so a clone must produce a distinct shard for every seat or reconstruction fails. Because a sable trellis of fake identities all draws from the same generator, one missing shard collapses the structure and the zephyr of easy credit stops. Cost: one genuine receipt per clone per epoch, which is the work itself.
